name: techlingo-video
description: Vidéo de présentation TechLingo (Remotion). Indépendant de l'app : ses dépendances restent ici.

scripts.encode: node scripts/encode.mjs build/vertical-master.mp4 ../public/decouvrir/video/techlingo-vertical.mp4 && node scripts/encode.mjs build/landscape-master.mp4 ../public/decouvrir/video/techlingo-landscape.mp4
scripts.posters: remotion still Vertical ../public/decouvrir/video/techlingo-vertical-poster.png --frame=250 --image-format=png && remotion still Landscape ../public/decouvrir/video/techlingo-landscape-poster.png --frame=250 --image-format=png
scripts.all: npm run voice && npm run sounds && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:landscape && npm run encode && npm run posters
